organisationTab.structureHint: Add a unit, rename it, move it under another parent, set its level and its head, or take it out of service. Every other module follows the structure recorded here.
organisationTab.readOnly: You may read the structure but not change it. Ask a Knowledge Administrator for the access.
organisationTab.noUnits: No unit has been recorded yet.
organisationTab.head: Head of the unit
organisationTab.cycleError: A unit cannot be moved under one of its own sub units. Choose a different parent.
organisationTab.codeTaken: Another unit already uses this code.
organisationTab.membersHint: Paste a list of email addresses to place people in a unit. The unit also becomes their department, so every other module follows.
organisationTab.emailsHint: Separate the addresses with a comma, a semicolon or a new line. A CSV column pasted straight in works too.
organisationTab.assignResult: {matched} addresses matched an account, and {added} people were added to the unit.
organisationTab.unknownHint: Check the spelling, or create the account first, then assign again.
organisationTab.noEmails: No email address was found in what you pasted.
organisationTab.syncHint: Compare the structure in SiaNexus against the published source. Nothing changes until you tick a change and apply it.
organisationTab.syncIdle: Run the check to see what differs from the published source.
organisationTab.syncNotFetched: The published source has not been fetched yet, so there is nothing to compare against.
organisationTab.syncNoChanges: The structure matches the published source. There is nothing to apply.
organisationTab.strategyOfficeHint: Members of this department may edit the Council Strategy: its levels, indicators, targets and actual values. Everyone else reads it.
organisationTab.councilSaved: The Strategy Office has been saved
organisationTab.knowledgeTypesHint: These are the knowledge types the Organisation module publishes on a unit page. They are fixed in the taxonomy and cannot be edited here.
